 Parepare Weather Forecast: Potential Rain Today, Here's the Outlook for Tonight's PSM vs Persija Match
 The BMKG forecasts potential rain in Parepare today, but conditions around Gelora B.J. Habibie Stadium are expected to be clear during the PSM vs Persija match.
 By: Fadhila Nuraini 
 | 
 Editor: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Contributor: Adit Pranata 
 November 21, 2026 at 6:12 PM WITA ·
 6 min read
 The atmosphere at Gelora B.J. Habibie Stadium, Parepare, the venue for the PSM Makassar vs Persija Jakarta match on Saturday (11/21/2026). The BMKG forecasts clear weather around the stadium at the 8:00 PM WITA kick-off. (Photo: Fahmi Akbar/Aktualita.co) 
 PAREPARE, Aktualita.co -  The weather in Parepare City, South Sulawesi, on Saturday (11/21/2026) is a point of concern ahead of the PSM Makassar vs Persija Jakarta match at Gelora B.J. Habibie Stadium. The Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) predicts that several areas in Parepare have the potential for light rain, although conditions around the stadium are expected to be clearer at night. 
 The 10th week match of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League is scheduled to start at 8:00 PM WITA (7:00 PM WIB). Thousands of supporters from both teams are expected to attend the match, which pits Juku Eja against the current league leaders. 
 Advertisement 
 Based on information from the weather forecast by the BMKG accessed on Saturday (11/21/2026), the districts of Bacukiki, Ujung, and Soreang have the potential for light rain throughout the day. Meanwhile, West Bacukiki District is generally expected to be cloudy. 
 The difference in conditions between districts is a concern because the weather in one part of Parepare is not necessarily the same as in the area around Gelora B.J. Habibie Stadium. 
 Parepare Weather Forecast Today According to BMKG 
 The BMKG estimates that air temperatures in Parepare City on Saturday will range from 24 to 34 degrees Celsius, depending on the area. 
 In Bacukiki District, temperatures are expected to range from 24–33 degrees Celsius with humidity between 73–97 percent. This area is categorized under the light rain forecast. 
 Similar conditions apply to Ujung and Soreang Districts, which are expected to experience light rain with temperatures around 24–34 degrees Celsius. 
 Meanwhile, West Bacukiki District is expected to be cloudy with temperatures of 25–34 degrees Celsius and humidity of 77–95 percent. 
 The forecast indicates that the public still needs to anticipate weather changes even if some areas of Parepare experience clear or cloudy conditions in the morning. 
 Rain predicted in one district does not mean the entire area will be hit by rain with the same intensity and timing. 
 Weather at Gelora B.J. Habibie Stadium During PSM vs Persija 
 What are the weather conditions at the PSM Makassar vs Persija Jakarta match location? 
 Gelora B.J. Habibie Stadium is located in Lompoe Village, Bacukiki District, Parepare City. For that location, the BMKG forecast shows relatively favorable conditions ahead of the match. 
 At 5:00 PM WITA, the Lompoe area is expected to be clear with temperatures around 26 degrees Celsius. 
 Entering 8:00 PM WITA, coinciding with the kick-off time, the weather is expected to remain clear with temperatures around 26 degrees Celsius. 
 Then at 11:00 PM WITA, weather conditions are expected to turn cloudy with temperatures around 25 degrees Celsius. 
 Thus, based on the hourly forecast for the Lompoe area, the PSM vs Persija match is not expected to take place in rainy conditions at kick-off. 
 However, these conditions cannot be fully guaranteed. Weather forecasts can change following the development of rain clouds and local atmospheric dynamics. 
 Spectators planning to come to the stadium are still advised to monitor the latest BMKG information before leaving. 
 BMKG Warns of Potential Rain in South Sulawesi 
 More broadly, the BMKG warns the public about atmospheric activity that still has the potential to trigger rain in several regions of Indonesia during the period of November 20–26, 2026. 
 In the weekly weather forecast published on November 19, South Sulawesi is among the regions that need to be wary of an increase in rain intensity to the moderate category during the period of November 20–22, 2026. 
 This information does not mean that the entire South Sulawesi region will experience moderate rain simultaneously. 
 Conditions in each area are influenced by local weather developments, so city or village-level forecasts are still needed to obtain a more detailed picture. 
 For the people of Parepare, attention should be paid to the possibility of weather changes from afternoon to evening, before the football match takes place at night. 
 Can Rain Affect PSM vs Persija? 
 Football matches in open stadiums are not immune to the influence of weather conditions. 
 If it rains before the match, the pitch surface can become wetter. This situation has the potential to affect the speed of the ball, player footing, and the effectiveness of passes. 
 A ball moving on wet grass sometimes slides faster, while players need to adjust their balance when changing direction or competing for the ball. 
 However, the impact depends on the intensity of the rain, the field's drainage capacity, and the condition of the grass when the match takes place. 
 As of the time this forecast was compiled, there is no basis to conclude that the PSM Makassar vs Persija Jakarta match will be disrupted by the weather. 
 The match remains subject to the official schedule of the competition operator, namely Saturday night at 8:00 PM WITA. 
 PSM Makassar Hopes for Supporter Support in Parepare 
 Amidst the attention on the weather, PSM Makassar is preparing to face one of the most important matches of this season. 
 Persija Jakarta arrives as the current leader of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League with 21 points from nine matches. 
 Meanwhile, PSM is still trying to improve its position after collecting 10 points in the same number of matches. 
 PSM coach, Darije Kalezic, hopes that the direct support of the supporters can provide an extra boost for his players to face Persija. 
 “I hope the supporters give their best support because we will really need it later.” — Darije Kalezic, PSM Makassar coach, in a press conference on Friday (11/20/2026). 
 This support is considered important because PSM is facing an opponent with quite consistent performance throughout the early season. 
 Kalezic also emphasized the need for discipline and high fighting spirit to match the strength of the Macan Kemayoran. 
 Meanwhile, Persija is trying to maintain a positive trend after undergoing preparations during the competition break. 
 Tips for Watching PSM vs Persija When the Weather is Uncertain 
 For supporters who will watch the match in person, weather conditions are one of the things that should be considered before heading to the stadium. 
 Spectators can prepare light raincoats as an anticipatory measure in case it rains on the way or when entering the stadium area. 
 Using comfortable and non-slip footwear is also important, especially if the road surface or access to the stands is wet. 
 In addition, spectators should arrive early to reduce the risk of getting stuck in traffic congestion before the match. 
 Temperature conditions that are still quite warm with high humidity also need to be considered. Maintaining adequate body fluids before and during the match can help maintain comfort. 
 The latest weather information can be checked through official BMKG channels, including hourly forecasts and early warnings if there are significant weather developments. 
 With a clear forecast in the Lompoe area at 8:00 PM WITA, the PSM Makassar vs Persija Jakarta match has the opportunity to take place without rain interference at kick-off. 
 Even so, the public still needs to pay attention to weather developments until the match ends, considering that the potential for light rain still exists in several areas of Parepare City.
